name: creator
text: When a request asks for a CLI's real error texts, take them from the installed CLI: grep its binary for the message literals and run it once in a clean environment with a credential or model that fails before the model runs (an invalid token, an unknown model) to measure the output shape; on a hosted machine the host may supply credentials even with HOME and the environment cleared, and a call that succeeds spends tokens. Label each text measured or read.
